title: Computer Science & Programming Assessment
subject: Computer Science
description: Standard CBT assessment covering Data Structures, Web Concepts, Algorithms, and Software Principles.

questions.text: What is the worst-case time complexity of quicksort when using a naive pivot selection (e.g., always choosing the first element) on an already sorted array?
questions.explanation: When an array is already sorted and the first element is always chosen as pivot, the partitioning yields subproblems of size 0 and n-1, resulting in O(n²) worst-case runtime.

questions.text: Which HTTP status code corresponds to '401'?
questions.explanation: HTTP 401 indicates that the request requires user authentication. HTTP 403 indicates Forbidden (server understands but refuses).

questions.text: In relational database design, which Normal Form eliminates transitive dependencies of non-prime attributes on the primary key?
questions.explanation: 3NF requires the relation to be in 2NF and that no non-prime attribute is transitively dependent on any candidate key (A -> B -> C).

questions.text: Which data structure operates on a Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) access pattern?
questions.explanation: A Stack works on Last-In, First-Out (LIFO), whereas a Queue operates on First-In, First-Out (FIFO).

questions.text: Which JavaScript method is used in single-page applications to add an entry to the browser's session history without reloading the page?
questions.explanation: history.pushState() adds a state entry to the browser's session history stack without initiating a network navigation or page refresh.

questions.text: In modern operating systems, which condition is NOT one of Coffman's four conditions required for a deadlock to occur?
questions.explanation: The four Coffman conditions are: 1) Mutual Exclusion, 2) Hold and Wait, 3) No Preemption, 4) Circular Wait. Therefore, 'Preemption' prevents deadlocks; 'No Preemption' is the necessary condition.

questions.text: Which transport layer protocol provides connection-oriented, reliable, and ordered delivery of byte streams?
questions.explanation: TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) is connection-oriented and provides reliable, ordered, and error-checked delivery of a stream of octets.

questions.text: What does CSS property 'display: flex' establish on an element?
options: A block formatting context with floats
A flex formatting context for all direct children
questions.explanation: Setting display: flex turns the element into a flex container and establishes a flex formatting context for its direct children (flex items).

title: General Aptitude & Logical Reasoning
subject: Aptitude
description: General numerical aptitude, pattern recognition, and analytical reasoning test for competitive CBT examination.

questions.text: Find the next number in the sequence: 3, 7, 15, 31, 63, ...
A train 180 meters long is running at a speed of 54 km/h. How many seconds will it take to pass a stationary telegraph post?
questions.explanation: Speed = 54 * (5/18) = 15 m/s. Time = Distance / Speed = 180 / 15 = 12 seconds.

questions.text: If in a certain code language, 'ROBOT' is coded as 'TQDQV', what is the code for 'SMART'?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by +2 in the alphabet: S(+2)=U, M(+2)=O, A(+2)=C, R(+2)=T, T(+2)=V => UOCTV.

questions.text: A shopkeeper sells an article at a 20% discount on marked price and still makes a 20% profit. If the cost price is $200, what is the marked price?
questions.explanation: Selling Price = 200 * 1.20 = $240. If Marked Price is M, 0.80 * M = 240 => M = 240 / 0.8 = $300.
